create_metric_tracker: create a Metric instance to track named metrics with running average, EMA, and last-value modes
update_metric_values: update a Metric instance with new values to compute cumulative statistics across iterations
get_stat_string: get a formatted string summary of all tracked metrics and iteration count from a Metric instance
compute_vqa_ranks: compute VQA answer accuracy and rank using VqaMetric.compute_ranks with scores and labels tensors
dump_metric_log: dump metric names and stats history to a JSON file using Metric.dump_log
